items.question: How do I verify my identity?
items.answer: Follow the guided flow in Settings > Safety. You'll need a valid document and a dynamic selfie.

items.question: Can I use Xder only for friendships?
items.answer: Yes. Set your goals to 'Friendship' and you'll receive matches aligned with that intention.

items.question: How do I edit my interests?
items.answer: Visit your profile, tap 'Edit interests' and select up to 12 chips. Drag and drop to reorder them.

items.question: What is the social energy mode?
items.answer: A scale showing how much interaction you want this week. Adjust it so recommendations match your actual plans.

items.question: What if someone breaks the rules?
items.answer: Use the report and block option. Our team prioritizes every report and keeps you informed.

items.question: How do I share my location with a friend?
items.answer: Activate the safety button before meeting and choose trusted contacts. They'll receive temporary alerts.

items.question: What happens when I disable incognito mode?
items.answer: You'll appear in searches again. Your previous privacy filters remain active so you decide who sees you.

items.question: Can I schedule check-in reminders?
items.answer: Yes, from the safety screen select times and contacts. Pause alerts whenever you're home.

items.question: How do I upgrade my plan?
items.answer: Go to Settings > Subscription and choose the desired plan. Changes apply immediately and are prorated.

items.question: Do you offer student discounts?
items.answer: Yes, submit your academic email under promotions and validate your identity for a 30% discount.

items.question: Which payment methods are supported?
items.answer: Debit and credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and local transfers in selected countries.

items.question: Can I cancel auto-renewal?
items.answer: Absolutely. Cancel from the app or contact support before the next billing cycle.

items.question: Who can view my profile?
items.answer: Only people matching your filters for age, goals and distance, plus the groups you join.

items.question: How do favorites work?
items.answer: Save profiles or groups. Nobody gets notified until you start the conversation.

items.question: What is travel visibility?
items.answer: Appear in the city you'll visit for a limited time to organize plans in advance.

items.question: Can I hide my online status?
items.answer: Yes, from Settings > Privacy. People will see a relative time instead of a green dot.

items.question: What is your average response time?
items.answer: Under 6 hours for critical reports and 12 hours for general questions.

items.question: Do you offer phone support?
items.answer: We schedule calls for sensitive cases and assist during reports.

items.question: Can I suggest a new feature?
items.answer: Yes, vote or propose ideas directly from the public roadmap.

items.question: Where can I find tutorials?
items.answer: The Help Center includes step-by-step articles with screenshots and short videos.
